surface.name: GlanceDefaultUI
surface.summary: Main entry point for Default UI. Singleton-style static methods; call setVisitorParams, then start or setPresence, and setDelegate to receive callbacks.
surface.usage_note: Call static methods. Set GlanceDefaultUI.setDelegate(yourDelegate) before starting a session.

methods.name: setVisitorParams
methods.summary: Sets the initial parameters for a visitor session (group ID, visitor ID, video). Required before starting a session. Can be called more than once; only groupid cannot be changed without relaunching the app.
methods.usage_snippet: GlanceDefaultUI.setVisitorParams(_ params: GlanceVisitorInitParams, timeout: Double?, maxConnectAttempts: Int = 0, fetchSettingsInterval: GlanceDefaultUI.SettingsInterval = .never, isDefaultPresenceIntegrationEnabled: Bool = true, isDefaultTwoWayVideoIntegration: Bool = true, isDefaultRenderModeIntegration: Bool = true)

methods.name: start
methods.summary: Starts a session with optional key and video mode. Default UI shows App Share or App Share + Video dialog, then session key for the agent to join. Use nil key for random 4-digit key.
methods.usage_snippet: GlanceDefaultUI.start(key: String? = nil, timeout: GlanceTimeout? = nil, videoMode: GlanceVideoMode)
methods.usage_note: Import GlanceCore. Use the enum case by name, e.g. VideoOff, not .VideoOff (e.g. videoMode: VideoOff). Valid values: VideoOff, VideoSmallVisitor, VideoLargeVisitor, VideoSmallMultiway, VideoLargeMultiway. Do not use .VideoOff, .videoOff, or .off.

methods.name: endSession
methods.summary: Ends the currently active session and cleans up resources.

methods.name: setPresence
methods.summary: Toggles the presence feature for real-time session initiation from an agent to a visitor (1-Click Connect). Call setVisitorParams with visitorid when using Presence.
methods.usage_snippet: GlanceDefaultUI.setPresence(_ isPresenceOn: Bool, timeout: Double? = nil, maxConnectAttempts: Int32? = nil)

methods.name: setDelegate
methods.summary: Assigns a delegate conforming to GlanceUIDelegate to receive session, presence, video, and error callbacks.

methods.name: startHostedSession
methods.summary: Starts a hosted session (agent-initiated). Agent authenticates with Glance username and password; guest does not need group ID.

methods.name: stopHostedSession
methods.summary: Stops the current hosted session.

surface.name: GlanceVideoMode
surface.summary: Enum for the videoMode parameter of GlanceDefaultUI.start(key:timeout:videoMode:). Import GlanceCore; use case name directly.
surface.usage_note: Import GlanceCore. Reference by name: VideoOff, VideoSmallVisitor, VideoLargeVisitor, VideoSmallMultiway, VideoLargeMultiway (e.g. videoMode: VideoOff). Do not use .VideoOff or .videoOff.

surface.name: SettingsInterval
surface.summary: Enum for fetchSettingsInterval in GlanceDefaultUI.setVisitorParams (7.1 only). Use GlanceDefaultUI.SettingsInterval to avoid compile errors.
surface.usage_note: Valid values: .never, .always, .repeating(Int). Example: fetchSettingsInterval: .never or .repeating(3600). Always qualify as GlanceDefaultUI.SettingsInterval (not SettingsInterval alone).

surface.name: GlanceVisibility
surface.usage_note: Valid values: tab, full. Use GlanceVisibility.tab or .full.

surface.name: GlanceLocation
surface.usage_note: Valid values: topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft, bottomRight. Use GlanceLocation.topLeft or .topRight, .bottomLeft, .bottomRight.

surface.name: GlanceTimeout
surface.summary: Timeout for GlanceDefaultUI.start(key:timeout:videoMode:). Not an enum; construct with time and type.
surface.usage_note: Use GlanceTimeout(timeInSeconds: Double, type: GlanceTimeout.TimeoutType). TimeoutType values: .default, .network. Do not use raw strings.

surface.name: GlanceError
surface.summary: Error passed to GlanceUIDelegate.onError(_ error: GlanceError). Has .code and .message.
surface.usage_note: error.code is EventCode (7.1) or GlanceSDKEventCode (7.2). Use exact enum case names (e.g. .EventStartSessionFailed, .EventInvalidParameter). error.message is the description string.

surface.name: GlanceSDKEventCode
surface.summary: Error/event codes in GlanceError.code (7.2). In 7.1 the type is EventCode with same case names.
surface.usage_note: Valid values (use exact names): EventNone, EventInvalidParameter, EventInvalidState, EventStartSessionFailed, EventJoinFailed, EventSessionEnded, EventPresenceConnected, EventPresenceConnectFail, EventPresenceShowTerms, EventPresenceDisconnected, EventVisitorInitialized, EventConnectionWarning, EventClearWarning, EventGuestCountChange, and others. Use e.g. error.code == .EventStartSessionFailed.

surface.name: GlanceUIDelegate
surface.summary: Implement this protocol and pass your object to GlanceDefaultUI.setDelegate(_:) to receive session, presence, video, and error callbacks.
surface.usage_note: Implement all methods (or provide empty bodies). SDK calls these; you do not call them.

methods.name: sessionConnected
methods.summary: Called by the SDK when the session is connected (waiting for agent). Default UI shows waiting dialog. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.sessionConnected to be notified.

methods.name: presenceDidConnect
methods.summary: Called when Presence has connected. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.presenceDidConnect to update UI (e.g. connection status).

methods.name: presenceDidDisconnect
methods.summary: Called when Presence has disconnected. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.presenceDidDisconnect to update UI.

methods.name: presenceSessionStarted
methods.summary: Called when a session has been started via Presence. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.presenceSessionStarted to be notified.

methods.name: presenceShowTerms
methods.summary: Called when the agent has requested a session and terms should be shown. Default UI shows Start or Share Video dialog. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.presenceShowTerms to be notified.

methods.name: receivedSessionCode
methods.summary: Called when a session code has been received. Default UI shows the code dialog. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.receivedSessionCode to be notified (e.g. for logging).

methods.name: sessionEnded
methods.summary: Called when the session has ended. Default UI hides dialogs and ends session UI. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.sessionEnded to be notified.

methods.name: sessionAgentConnected
methods.summary: Called when an agent has joined the session. Default UI hides waiting dialog and starts screen share (and video if configured). Implement GlanceUIDelegate.sessionAgentConnected to be notified.

methods.name: onGuestCountChange
methods.summary: Called when the number of guests (agents) in the session changes. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.onGuestCountChange to be notified.

methods.name: receivedVideoCaptureImage
methods.summary: Called when a video capture image is received. Default UI updates session coordinator. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.receivedVideoCaptureImage if needed.

methods.name: didStartVideoCapture
methods.summary: Called when visitor video capture has started. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.didStartVideoCapture to be notified.

methods.name: didStopVideoCapture
methods.summary: Called when visitor video capture has stopped. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.didStopVideoCapture to be notified.

methods.name: didStartPreviewVideoCapture
methods.summary: Called when the preview video capture (camera preview before/during session) has started. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.didStartPreviewVideoCapture if needed.

methods.name: didStopPreviewVideoCapture
methods.summary: Called when the preview video capture has stopped. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.didStopPreviewVideoCapture if needed.

methods.name: didPauseVisitorVideo
methods.summary: Called when the visitor has paused their video. Default UI updates session (e.g. paused state). Implement GlanceUIDelegate.didPauseVisitorVideo to be notified.

methods.name: didStartAgentViewer
methods.summary: Called when the agent viewer (agent video/cursor view) is available. Default UI shows it in session. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.didStartAgentViewer to be notified.

methods.name: didStopAgentViewer
methods.summary: Called when the agent viewer has been removed. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.didStopAgentViewer to be notified.

methods.name: onUpdateVisibility
methods.summary: Called when widget visibility (tab vs full) changes. Default UI updates session coordinator. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.onUpdateVisibility to be notified.

methods.name: onUpdateLocation
methods.summary: Called when widget location (corner) changes. Default UI updates session coordinator. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.onUpdateLocation to be notified.

methods.name: onUpdateSize
methods.summary: Called when widget/size update is received. Default UI updates session. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.onUpdateSize to be notified.

methods.name: askForVideoSession
methods.summary: Called when the SDK needs confirmation to start a video session. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.askForVideoSession and call confirmAction or cancelAction.

methods.name: agentAskedForVideoSession
methods.summary: Called when the agent has requested to start video. Default UI shows Share Video dialog. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.agentAskedForVideoSession to be notified.

methods.name: onUpdateAgentVideo
methods.summary: Called when agent video state is updated. Default UI shows agent video. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.onUpdateAgentVideo to be notified.

methods.name: initTimeoutExpired
methods.summary: Called when the init (setVisitorParams) timeout has expired. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.initTimeoutExpired to inform the user.

methods.name: startTimeoutExpired
methods.summary: Called when the start-session timeout has expired (e.g. no agent joined in time). Implement GlanceUIDelegate.startTimeoutExpired to inform the user.

methods.name: presenceTimeoutExpired
methods.summary: Called when the Presence connection timeout has expired. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.presenceTimeoutExpired to inform the user.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.summary: Called when an SDK event occurs. Default UI forwards to this delegate method. Implement to receive events.

methods.name: onError
methods.summary: Called when an error occurs. Default UI forwards to delegate. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.onError to show errors to the user (error.code is EventCode, error.message is description).

methods.name: hostedSessionDidStart
methods.summary: Called when a hosted session has started. Default UI shows the session key. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.hostedSessionDidStart to be notified (e.g. display key).

methods.name: hostedSessionDidEnd
methods.summary: Called when the hosted session has ended. If errorMessage is non-empty, an error occurred. Implement GlanceUIDelegate.hostedSessionDidEnd to cleanup and optionally show the error.

surface.name: GlanceService
surface.summary: Optional: use when customizing dialogs or terms URL. Default UI uses this internally; you can provide a custom GlanceServiceType (e.g. custom termsUrl) when creating DialogsCoordinator.
surface.usage_note: Read or set termsUrl when supplying a custom service. Default init uses GlanceLocalizedStringsConstants.shareAppDialogURL.

properties.name: termsUrl
properties.summary: URL for terms and conditions shown in dialogs. Set in init or when creating a custom GlanceService.
